answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor trust in a reputation escrow with slashing: every agent posts a 500-token bond into escrow when joining, and peers stake small deposits on each other's honest behavior. If an agent is caught forging identities, its bond is slashed and split among reporters, so each fake account costs 500 tokens up front plus escalating losses. Fraudulent agents end up on a hollow ledge - plenty of accounts, but no one willing to back them - while honest agents keep a growing, auditable credit line that is far cheaper to maintain than to fake.
